comment: Frozen evaluation sets (SHSD program §20.2). Files listed here are immutable after publication; new versions get new names. Hash-bucket conventions define implicit frozen splits without copying data.

conventions.exact_split_rule: bucket = splitmix64(position_key) % 10; 0-7 train, 8 val, 9 test (training.rs, unchanged since Phase 2)
conventions.eval_thinning: second stream splitmix64(key ^ 0x5eed_ab1e_0f0f_0f0f), caps recorded per run (D029)

sets.name: fc_tiny_exact_valtest
sets.definition: Forward Chess tiny retrograde solution, buckets 8 (val) and 9 (test) under exact_split_rule

sets.name: fc_small_exact_valtest
sets.definition: Forward Chess small retrograde solution, buckets 8/9, thinned to ~20k states each under eval_thinning

sets.name: fc_full_shadow_v1
sets.definition: 300 fc-full positions from c03-champion selfplay trajectories (seed 1), labelled at 100/400/1600 shallow + 6400 deep + all-children 400 nodes by the c03 evaluator
sets.purpose: shadow-search diagnostic constant across Stage C+ evaluator work; never used for training or tuning
